title: OMW Kinship
name: omw-kin
tagline: Kinship terms in a thousand languages

main.description: The kinship concepts, with their hierarchy, definitions and words in every language.

provenance.description: Provenance records tracing every data point back to its source and original identifier.

about.intro:
OMW Kinship is a multilingual wordnet of kinship terms: one concept per kin type (such as father's brother's son), linked to the Collaborative Interlingual Index where possible, with words for them in over a thousand languages. It grew out of KinDiv, the database of lexical diversity in the kinship domain, extended with Kinbank, the TUFS Basic Vocabulary and the Open English WordNet.

Source and data on GitHub; the concept hierarchy can also be browsed as kin-type diagrams in the hierarchy browser.
about.citation: If you use OMW Kinship, please cite Khishigsuren et al. (2022) for KinDiv and Passmore et al. (2023) for Kinbank.  For the interface, please cite Maudslay and Bond (2026).
